blocks.summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Unnat Gram Abhiyan (PM-JUGA):

items: Goal: - Development of tribal villages and aspirational districts.
Coverage:- 63,000 villages, benefiting over 5 crore tribal people.
Budget: - ₹79,156 crore (₹56,333 crore central + ₹22,823 crore state funding).
